title: feat: consume ADR-0085 semantic roles from spec 11.7.0
body:
Consumer-side switch for [framework ADR-0085](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/framework/pull/2521) (spec 11.7.0). Closes the four dogfood-confirmed gaps:

## What
1. **Single-source fieldGroups derivation (§5)** — `plugin-form`'s `deriveFieldGroupSections` and `plugin-detail`'s `deriveFieldGroupDetailSections` are now thin adapters over spec's `deriveFieldGroupLayout`. Forms, the create/edit **modal** (#2152/#2154 pipeline) and detail pages render the SAME grouping from one implementation; the two near-identical local copies are gone (net **-90 lines**).
2. **Canonical `collapse` enum honoured everywhere** — `'none' | 'expanded' | 'collapsed'`; deprecated `collapsible`/`collapsed`/`defaultExpanded` spellings still read for pre-11.7 metadata (handled inside the shared derivation).
3. **`stageField: false` actually suppresses the stepper** — the `false` handling was wired to the removed `detail.stageField` key, so spec-authored `false` fell through to the name heuristic (browser-confirmed bug).
4. **`highlightFields` rename consumed** — default grid columns, card compact views, detail highlight strip, child-record preview and interface-page default columns read `highlightFields` with `compactLayout` fallback for pre-11.7 metadata.
5. **Dead reads removed** — never-authorable `objectDef.views.*` and the ADR-0085-removed `detail.*` hint block. `detail.renderViaSchema` survives only as the legacy-renderer kill-switch (dies with that path in a follow-up PR).

## Verification
- Unit: plugin-form 15 / plugin-detail 146 / app-shell 958 / plugin-grid 162 — all green.
- Browser (app-todo + HMR console against a live worktree server):
  - `stageField: false` → stepper GONE (was rendering pre-fix); `stageField: 'status'` → stepper renders.
  - `collapse: 'collapsed'` group renders as a collapsed card on the detail page, expandable.
  - Create **modal** shows the Planning group header (was flat — the main console entry surface).
  - Default list columns / highlight strip / card views driven by `highlightFields` (new spelling) and `compactLayout` (legacy spelling) both.
